scope: Bounded local work scheduler and seven deterministic models; no application/UI/radio integration in this milestone
controls: Coalesced wakeups, one operation at a time and fair progress past failing items
Closing a session cancels a delayed scan
Excessive/duplicate work lists fail before recovery callbacks
Failed scans cannot reuse previous work until a complete fresh scan
Descriptors are copied and pending work rechecks changed authority
An empty completed scan is not repeated for control-only revisions; durable input wakes it
New-input wake during an unfinished empty scan is preserved
limitations: The host must enforce fresh bytes, authority and session guards in each recover callback
The host must wake the scheduler after committing new input and create a new instance per unlocked session
This component does not implement encryption, transport, persisted payloads or user interface by itself
Application integration and complete product acceptance remain separate WIP; no iPhone/physical-radio/all-OS readiness claim
